claude = sys.argv[1]
def embedded(p):
    t = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read()
    return set(re.search(r"EMBEDDED_TOOLS = \"\"\"(.*?)\"\"\"", t, re.S).group(1).split())
a = embedded(os.path.join(claude, "skills/orkeon-crew-yaml/scripts/check_crew.py"))
b = embedded(os.path.join(claude, "skills/orkeon-crew-typescript/scripts/check_team.py"))

sec = ref.split("## 5. Tool catalogue")[1].split("### Not in the list above")[0]
r = set(re.findall(r"^\| `([a-z_]+)` \|", sec, re.M))
binary = "absent"
reference = re.search(r"`(\d+\.\d+\.\d+[^`]*)`,\s+(?:>\s+)?the\s+(?:>\s+)?version the image builds", ref)
if subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", "command -v orkeon"], capture_output=True).returncode == 0:
    env = dict(os.environ, HOME=tempfile.mkdtemp())
    env.pop("BRAVE_API_KEY", None)

        live = set(out.split())

want() {
  local root=$1 path=$2 kind=$3 what=$4 first
  first=$(printf '%s' "${what%%/*}" | tr A-Z a-z)
  case "$kind" in
    I1) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to the team folder itself: its agents would reach crew/, the launchers and mounts.json, and on a writable point leave an appsettings.json that the next run reads — bind a sub-folder such as ./${root#/}" ;;
    I2) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to ./$what, inside crew/: its agents would reach the definition of the team, and on a writable point change it or leave an appsettings.json that the next run reads — bind a folder of its own" ;;
    I4) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to ./$what: Orkeon looks for $first/appsettings.json in the team folder when it searches for settings above crew/, so that name is kept for settings — name the folder otherwise" ;;
    HOLDS) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to $path, which holds $what: its agents would reach it — bind a folder of its own" ;;
    INSIDE) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to $path, inside $what: its agents would reach it — bind a folder of its own" ;;
    OTHER_TEAM) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to $path, inside another team: the agents of a team never reach the folders of another — share through a folder of its own" ;;
    OTHER_SET) printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to $path, inside a mount set of another team: the agents of a team never reach the folders of another — share through a folder of its own" ;;
    OUTSIDE) printf '%s' "WARNING mounts.json: $root is bound to $path, outside the team folder: Orkeon Studio launches the team only when this folder is declared, spelled exactly, in its Authorized folders (a container path never matches there)" ;;
    WINDOWS) printf '%s' "WARNING mounts.json: $root is bound to the Windows path $path: the container cannot bind it, and Orkeon Studio only when it is declared, spelled exactly, in its Authorized folders" ;;
    DOT) what=${what#[}; printf '%s' "ERROR   mounts.json: $root is bound to $path, whose folder name \"${what%]}\" ends with a dot or a space: Windows drops them, so on the host Orkeon Studio and run.cmd would bind another folder — name the folder without them" ;;
  esac
}

  for c in $scripts; do

    done < "$f/rows"
  done
done
# /plugins is where orkeon-harness-run looks for plugins: read-only.
